metadata.desc: AstrBot built-in session, conversation, provider, persona, and plugin commands.

commands.help.tip: Tip: use `/help --image` to render the visual help card.
commands.help.image_callout: Use /help for the compact text version.
commands.session.info.group: Group ID: {group_id}. Set this ID to whitelist to allow the entire group.
commands.conversation.reset.no_provider: Cannot find any LLM provider. Configure one first.
commands.conversation.reset.no_conversation: You are not in a conversation. Use /conversation create to create one.
commands.conversation.stats.no_conversation: You are not in a conversation. Use /conversation create to create one.
commands.conversation.stats.empty: No stats available for this conversation yet.
commands.conversation.list.unsupported: Conversation listing is not supported for {runners}.
commands.conversation.create_for.ok: Group session {session} switched to a new conversation: {cid}.
commands.conversation.switch.invalid: Invalid conversation index. Use /conversation list to inspect available conversations.
commands.conversation.rename.empty: The conversation title cannot be empty.
commands.conversation.delete.none: There is no active conversation. Use /conversation create to create one or /conversation switch to enter another conversation.
commands.conversation.delete.ok: Deleted the current conversation. Use /conversation create to create one or /conversation switch to enter another conversation.
commands.task.stop.none: No running tasks in the current session.
commands.variable.set.ok: Stored {key} for this session. Use /variable unset to remove it.
commands.chat.status.enabled: LLM chat is enabled for the current session.
commands.chat.status.disabled: LLM chat is disabled for the current session.
commands.chat.set.enabled: LLM chat is now enabled for the current session.
commands.chat.set.disabled: LLM chat is now disabled for the current session.
commands.flow.status.body: Session streaming override is {mode}. Effective mode: {effective}.
commands.flow.set.on: Session streaming override is now on.
commands.flow.set.off: Session streaming override is now off.
commands.flow.unset.ok: Session streaming override removed; following global config.
commands.persona.status.no_conversation: Current conversation does not exist. Use /conversation create first.
commands.persona.unset.none: There is no active conversation to unset a persona from.
commands.persona.unset.ok: Persona unset for the current conversation.
commands.persona.set.none: There is no active conversation. Use /conversation create first.
commands.persona.set.missing: Persona does not exist. Use /persona list to inspect available personas.
commands.persona.set.no_conversation: Current conversation does not exist. Use /conversation create first.
commands.persona.set.force_warning: A session rule is forcing another persona, so this selection will not take effect yet.
commands.persona.set.ok: Persona updated. Use /conversation reset if you need a clean context after switching personas.{force_warning}
commands.plugin.list.body:
Loaded plugins:
{listing}
Use /plugin show <plugin> to inspect commands.
Use /plugin enable <plugin> or /plugin disable <plugin> to change its state.
commands.plugin.disable.demo: Cannot disable plugins in demo mode.
commands.plugin.enable.demo: Cannot enable plugins in demo mode.
commands.plugin.install.demo: Cannot install plugins in demo mode.
commands.plugin.show.tip: Tip: commands are triggered through the configured wake prefix, usually `/`.
commands.provider.list.llm_hint: Use /provider set llm <index> to switch LLM providers.
commands.provider.list.tts_hint: Use /provider set tts <index> to switch TTS providers.
commands.provider.list.stt_hint: Use /provider set stt <index> to switch STT providers.
commands.provider.models.not_found: Model `{model_name}` was not found in any configured provider.
commands.provider.models.switch_failed: Failed to switch provider and model: {error}
commands.provider.models.switched_provider: Switched provider to {provider_id} and selected model {model}.
commands.provider.models.none: Cannot find any LLM provider. Configure one first.
commands.provider.models.header: Available models for the current provider:
commands.provider.models.hint: Use /model set <name-or-index> to switch models. Model names can be resolved across configured providers.
